steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The English legal system is based on common law (judge-made law) and statute law (Acts of Parliament) | Key Fact: Parliament is the supreme law-making body — parliamentary sovereignty means no Parliament can bind its successors | Key Fact: The court hierarchy ensures that lower courts follow the decisions of higher courts (doctrine of precedent) | Key Fact: The Supreme Court is the highest court in the UK for civil and criminal matters
